title: Random Pick with Blacklist
description: Pick a random integer in [0, n-1] not in blacklist by mapping blacklisted numbers to available slots at the end of the range.
pseudocode:
1. M = n - length(blacklist)
2. Map blacklisted values >= M to valid values < M
3. Pick random r in [0, M-1]
4. Return mapping[r] if exists, else r

steps.note: Initialize range [0, 6], blacklist [2, 3, 5]. M = 7 - 3 = 4. Valid slots: [0, 1, 2, 3]
Map blacklisted numbers >= 4 (i.e., 5) to available slots < 4 (i.e., 2, 3). Map: {5 -> 2}
Pick 0: Random index 0 is valid. Return 0.
Pick 4: Random index 3 is mapped. 3 is not blacklisted. Return 4 is conceptually index 3.
Pick 6: Random index 2 is mapped. Return 6.
